h1: The 8 Best Nightstands with Charging Station of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Nightstands with Charging: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: eight nightstands with built-in charging for 2026, compared on outlets, USB-C ports, size, drawers and lighting.
summary: The Huuger rustic brown nightstand is our top pick for a no-frills build with 2 AC outlets, USB-A and USB-C. The VASAGLE CUSTOS is the pick for the most ports and the widest top. The Fixwal is the pick for narrow gaps beside the bed.
intro: Most shoppers count the outlets and ignore the footprint, then find the nightstand will not fit the gap beside their bed. Width and depth are the first checks, because a nightstand that is 23.6 inches wide is a different piece of furniture from one that is 15.7.
We reviewed eight nightstands with built-in charging and ranked them on port selection, size, storage and lighting features. Several are small, so measure the space first.

products.name: Huuger Nightstand with Charging Station, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: A straightforward charging nightstand with 2 AC outlets, USB-A and USB-C.
products.description:
This Huuger measures 15.7 inches wide, 11.8 deep and 23.6 high, and offers a pair of wall outlets, one USB-A jack, one USB-C jack, two fabric drawers and an open shelf. It uses P2 particleboard with powder-coated steel and has adjustable feet.

It wins because it covers the essentials without extras to go wrong, and sits in the $25-50 bracket. The tradeoff against the LED versions is no lighting.

It suits a standard bedroom. The surface is small, so it holds a lamp and a phone but not much more.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a charging nightstand without extras.

products.name: VASAGLE CUSTOS Nightstand, Ink Black, 23.6" Wide
products.verdict: 5 ports in total, a 99 lb top load rating and the widest surface here.
products.description:
The CUSTOS is 23.6 inches wide, 13.8 deep and 24.1 high, with five charging ports in total: two wall outlets, two USB-A jacks and a USB-C jack, a 99 lb tabletop load rating and a water and scratch resistant finish. It also has an app-controlled LED and gold handles.

It ranks second since it is the largest and costs $50-100, but it offers the most ports and room on top. That makes it better for a couple sharing one side.

It suits a roomy bedroom. Check it fits beside the bed.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want the most charging ports and the widest surface in one nightstand.

products.name: SUPERJARE Nightstand with Adjustable Drawer, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: A fabric drawer with 2 positions and 3-tier open shelves.
products.description:
The SUPERJARE is 15.7 inches wide, 11.8 deep and 23.4 high, with 1 USB-A, 1 USB-C and 2 AC outlets, an adjustable fabric drawer with 2 positions and 3-tier open shelves. It is stain resistant and sits in the $25-50 range.

It ranks third because the drawer adapts to different items, which the Huuger's fixed drawers do not, but it has less drawer storage overall.

It suits bedside clutter of varied sizes. Charging matches the Huuger.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a drawer that adapts to different item sizes.

products.name: Huuger Night Stand with LED and Charging Station, Black
products.verdict: The Huuger design with 60,000 colors, music sync and 12 scenes.
products.description:
This Huuger shares the 15.7 by 11.8 by 23.6 inch frame and the same pair of wall outlets plus USB-A and USB-C jacks as the rustic model, adding LED lighting with 60,000 colors, music sync, app control and 12 scenes. It has 2 fabric drawers and is in the $25-50 bracket.

It ranks fourth since the lighting is an extra over the first pick at the same price tier, and not everyone wants a glowing nightstand.

It suits buyers who like ambient lighting. Skip it for a calm bedroom.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want app-controlled ambient lighting built in.

products.name: Lazzanto Nightstand with LED Strip, Black
products.verdict: LED strip with app, timer, voice control and music sync.
products.description:
The Lazzanto is 15.6 inches wide, 11.4 deep and 24.4 high, with 2 USB and 2 AC outlets, an LED strip with app, timer, voice control and music sync, 2 fabric drawers, a water-resistant top and rounded corners. It is in the $25-50 range.

It ranks fifth because the USB ports are listed without a USB-C count, unlike the Huuger. Its distinction is voice control and a timer.

It suits buyers who want hands-free lighting. Confirm the USB-C availability on the listing.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want voice-controlled LED lighting with a timer.
products.skipIf: You need a confirmed USB-C port.

products.name: Fixwal Night Stand with RGB LED, Black
products.verdict: A narrow, deep footprint of 11.8 by 15.7 inches with a 5 ft cord.
products.description:
The Fixwal is 11.8 inches wide and 15.7 deep, 23.6 high, with 2 AC outlets and 2 USB, an RGB LED with a music sync app, 2 fabric drawers, a 2-layer shelf and a 5 ft cord. It sits at $25-50.

It ranks sixth because its USB count lacks a confirmed USB-C, but the narrow width fits tighter bedside gaps than the 15.7 inch wide models.

It suits a small room with limited side space.
products.idealFor: Tight bedside gaps where a narrow, deep footprint fits.
products.skipIf: You have no depth to spare.

products.name: ADORNEVE White Nightstand with Sliding Top Charging Station
products.verdict: A sliding top hides the charging station until you need it.
products.description:
The ADORNEVE is 17.72 inches wide, 15.75 deep and 23.62 high, made of engineered wood. A sliding top reveals a hidden charging station with 2 outlets and 2 USB, plus an RGB LED app and 2 drawers. It is in the $50-100 range.

It ranks seventh because it costs more than the basic Huuger for a similar port count, but the hidden station keeps the top clean.

It suits buyers who dislike visible cords.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a charging station hidden until needed.

products.name: JARHETUN Night Stand Set of 2 with LED, Black
products.verdict: Two matching nightstands, each with its own ports and LED.
products.description:
This set has two tables, each 15 inches wide, 11.2 deep and 26.4 high, with 2 USB and 2 AC outlets, an RGB LED with app and music sync, 3 fabric drawers, a metal mesh fence and an anti-tip kit. It is in the $50-100 range for the pair.

It ranks last only because few buyers need two, but a matched pair with ports on each side is hard to beat on value.

It suits couples who want charging on both sides of the bed.
cons: Need two for it to pay off
products.idealFor: Buyers who need matching charging nightstands on both sides of the bed.

whatMatters.detail: AC outlets run lamps and chargers, USB-A suits older cables and USB-C suits newer phones and tablets. A nightstand without USB-C limits fast charging. Check the port list in the specs.
The listings range from 11.8 to 23.6 inches wide. A piece that does not fit the gap is a return. Measure the gap beside the bed before buying.
Fabric drawers hold small items while open shelves keep books in reach. Decide what you keep beside the bed. Check drawer and shelf counts.
LED strips add ambience but also add app and wiring to manage. Plain models are simpler. Check whether the listing mentions LED or app control.
A lightweight nightstand can tip, which matters with children. An anti-tip kit helps. Look for it in the listing.

faq.q: Do all charging nightstands have USB-C?
faq.a: No. The Huuger, SUPERJARE and VASAGLE list USB-C, while several others list only USB.
Skipping the measurements. The listings range from 11.8 to 23.6 inches wide.

faq.q: Is the VASAGLE worth it over the Huuger?
faq.a: If you want 5 ports and a 99 lb top, yes. The Huuger is smaller and costs less.

faq.q: How do I set up the lights?
faq.a: LED models use an app. Follow each listing's pairing steps.

faq.q: Do I need an anti-tip kit?
faq.a: It is wise with children. The JARHETUN set includes one.

faq.q: Can I clean the top easily?
faq.a: The Lazzanto lists a water-resistant top and the VASAGLE lists water and scratch resistance.

finalTake: The Huuger rustic brown is the safest all-round choice with USB-C at $25-50. Pick the VASAGLE CUSTOS for the most ports and surface, or the Fixwal for narrow gaps. If you want LED, the Huuger black version adds it at the same tier.
